name: Clinics and medical groups

seo.title: Google Reviews & Hours for Clinic Groups | SAAYT
seo.description: Professional replies to patient reviews across every clinic branch on Google without exposing health details plus accurate holiday hours

h1: Every clinic branch earns the same trust on Google
lead: Patients choose a clinic from its reviews and hours before they call. SAAYT helps you reply professionally in every branch without revealing any health information

pains.d: Replying to a patient needs care because details about their condition never belong in a public reply
Ramadan and holiday hours differ by branch and patients need to know before booking
Many negative reviews are about waiting and reception and need a quick calm reply

helps.d: Professional drafts that avoid health details and are approved by your team
Ramadan and holiday hours for every branch from one template
Instant alerts for low ratings in any branch

example.review: The doctor was great but the wait was very long even with an appointment
example.reply: Thank you for your feedback and we apologise for the wait despite your booked appointment. Your note has reached the branch management to review scheduling and we would be glad to hear from you directly so we can serve you better
example.note: The reply mentions no details about the visit or treatment

faq.a: Yes. Drafts are designed to avoid health information and every reply is reviewed by someone on your team before it posts
Yes. Each branch is its own profile and permissions can be set per branch
